The proposed approach is **hierarchical epidemic control with penalties for non-compliance**: higher-level policymakers impose costs on jurisdictions under their authority for deviating from recommended policies, such as fines, litigation costs, or reputational harm (https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.10646).

These penalties make avoiding recommended restrictions costly, counteracting the incentive to escape the burdens of control while benefiting from other jurisdictions’ stricter measures (https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.10646).
